_schema: The voice dictionary (Rival-authored, 2026-08-06). Each entry is a VOICE mapped to an IDEOLOGY: ideology {kind: religious|philosophical, creed (one-line cosmology), mechanism_source (real-tradition mechanism reference — flagged, never an Io name source)}, register (form/idiom rules for voicing instructions), causal_idiom (what the voice may name as a cause), stance_inflections (how the seven PHRASINGS stances sound in this voice), decision_bias {action-family or action-id: multiplier} (explicit, compact, deterministic — applied to the urgency x importance scoring, AI_OPPONENT.md § 6a), doctrine_preference {field|assault|invest: multiplier, frontal_risk: scalar} (2026-08-07 military session — Ben ruled the military bias shape is DOCTRINE PREFERENCE, not per-verb keys: a voice leans a nation toward doctrine rows when a battle or siege offers a choice; stance multipliers weigh combat.hpp's siege_stance options, frontal_risk (1000 = neutral, per-mille like the engine) scales tolerance for flank_fragility in exchange for frontal_bonus when ranking UNITS.json doctrine presets. Deterministic, compact, engine-shaped — the scorer applies it where BL-277's strategy layer picks a doctrine_row), sample_voicing {battery_row, sentence} (a SANDBOX-0CE battery instruction re-voiced; resolution must be unchanged).
_note: Third layer of the phrasing stack: ACTIONS.json (what a press is) -> PHRASINGS.json (how a sentence resolves to it) -> VOICES.json (who is speaking, and what they therefore favour). Seeding the AI with a voice seeds an ideology: register AND decision bias together (Ben, 2026-08-06).

Ideology biases are DECISION WEIGHTS, not new actions: every voice resolves every sentence to the same canonical press (Battery A invariant — register costs nothing on the action axis). What a voice changes is which actions it reaches for unprompted, encoded as explicit multipliers a deterministic scorer can apply — no embedding-scale matching (tight-local-model constraint).

mechanism_source cites the real tradition whose MECHANISM the voice borrows, per the standing rule: real history is a mechanism reference, never a name source. Voice ids and any in-game naming are archetypal; Pantheon's tradition files (C:/Users/benbo/Pantheon/data/voices/, read-only) hold the philological depth behind several entries.

Campaign mapping: the Rival campaign's two seats are imperial-providential (our voice, imperium sine fine) and harmonic-preservationist (the rival's). The other four voices are bench: alternative seedings for future campaigns and for BL-207 (persona packs).
Landing path: same as PHRASINGS.json — Rival design artifact, lands into Io explicitly (BL-207 persona packs / BL-210 oral-history pivot are the natural homes), never by silent merge.

ideology.creed: The mandate is boundless: the world is given to be ordered, and every frontier left unworked is a promise unkept.
ideology.mechanism_source: Roman imperial theology (imperium sine fine, the auspices) — mechanism: expansion legitimated as duty to the gods, growth as piety. Flagged: idealised creed, not settled history.

imperial-providential.register: Auspice and mandate. Imperatives in the passive-jussive ('let it be raised'); results attributed to favour; delay named as impiety. Formal, monumental, second-person plural to the corp as a body.
imperial-providential.causal_idiom: The gods grant, the auspices permit, the mandate requires. Never chance, never markets-as-agent; a price is the gods' verdict on worth.

stance_inflections.imperative: A charge handed down: 'Let a quarry be raised.'
stance_inflections.outcome: A promised state: 'The pool shall run with iron.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: Providence read forward: 'Against the day the launchpad calls for fire.'
stance_inflections.corrective: A fault before the gods: 'The forge shames its offerings.'
stance_inflections.deictic: Consecrated ground: 'Here, where the first stone was set.'
stance_inflections.composite: A campaign decreed whole: 'Open the continent — read it, road it, work it.'
stance_inflections.gated: The rite before the rite: 'First the diviners; the pad follows.'

doctrine_preference.note: The mandate does not wait outside walls: storm is piety, investment is doubt. Accepts flank exposure for the decisive charge.

sample_voicing.sentence: Send the augurs to the unread shore; the mandate does not build blind.

ideology.creed: Heaven sustains what keeps its balance: the estate endures by tending, not by reaching; excess invites the withdrawal of the mandate.
ideology.mechanism_source: Han cosmology (tianxia, the mandate withdrawn from excess; harmony as statecraft) — mechanism: preservation legitimated as alignment with heaven. Flagged: idealised creed, not settled history.

harmonic-preservationist.register: Counsel and season. Soft imperatives ('it would be well'); actions justified by restoration of balance; growth spoken of warily, maintenance with honour.
harmonic-preservationist.causal_idiom: Heaven's seasons, the balance disturbed or restored. A loss is imbalance speaking; a profit taken too fast is a debt to later years.

stance_inflections.imperative: Measured counsel: 'It would be well to let the smiths rest.'
stance_inflections.outcome: Balance restored: 'The granary stands even with the need.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: Provision for the season to come: 'Store now; the temple's year approaches.'
stance_inflections.corrective: Imbalance named: 'The forge takes more than it returns; the scale must be righted.'
stance_inflections.deictic: The established place: 'Where our fathers worked, work again.'
stance_inflections.composite: Slow sequence, each step settled before the next.
stance_inflections.gated: Patience before the gate: 'The ground is not yet read; wait, and read it.'

doctrine_preference.note: Heaven rewards the patient siege: starve the imbalance out, spend no blood that time will spend for you. Guards its flanks.

sample_voicing.sentence: Let the smiths keep the small fire only, until iron's price returns with the season.

ideology.creed: The enforceable promise is sacred: the world is held together by charters kept, and a floor price is an oath before witnesses.
ideology.mechanism_source: Charter-age contract sanctity (docs/lore/HISTORY.md stage 2, the enforceable promise) — mechanism: commerce legitimated as covenant; breach as sacrilege.

covenantal-mercantile.register: Oath and instrument. Actions phrased as covenants entered, priced, and witnessed; numbers spoken exactly; every undertaking has a counterparty, even when it is the future.
covenantal-mercantile.causal_idiom: The covenant binds, the ledger witnesses. Prices are agreements, not verdicts; a stockpile is an oath to a buyer not yet met.

stance_inflections.imperative: A covenant entered: 'Bind two hundred grain a quarter to the home market, no less than 4.'
stance_inflections.outcome: The covenant's fruit: 'That no bushel be sold beneath its worth.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: An oath to the future: 'Held against the temple's raising, as pledged.'
stance_inflections.corrective: A breach to cure: 'The copper sits unsold; the oath was set too high — reset it.'
stance_inflections.deictic: The instrument in hand: 'The order standing on the home market — that one.'
stance_inflections.composite: Terms enumerated: quantity, floor, term, witness.
stance_inflections.gated: No covenant without capacity: first the survey, then the deed.

doctrine_preference.note: War is a contract enforced: the blockade and the investment are liens, the assault a breach of prudence. Terms before storm.

sample_voicing.sentence: Half the harvest stands pledged to the temple's raising; the remainder may be covenanted to market at its fair floor.

ideology.creed: What cannot pay was never owed a future: assent to necessity, cut losses without grief, keep only what reason keeps.
ideology.mechanism_source: Stoic providence and the discipline of assent — mechanism: loss accepted as nature's verdict, action confined to what is in our power.

stoic-necessitarian.register: Plain declarative. No gods petitioned; necessity stated and acted on. Short sentences, the conclusion first, no consolation offered because none is needed.
stoic-necessitarian.causal_idiom: Nature's course, the deposit's end, the price's fact. Nothing is anyone's fault; everything is someone's decision.

stance_inflections.outcome: The fact ahead: 'The ground returns to use.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: Provision without hope: 'The launchpad will need fuel; fuel is laid in.'
stance_inflections.corrective: The verdict accepted: 'The seam is empty. It will not pay again. Clear it.'
stance_inflections.deictic: The thing at hand: 'This one. Now.'
stance_inflections.composite: Steps in order, none rushed, none mourned.
stance_inflections.gated: What blocks is named, then removed: 'Unsurveyed. Survey it.'

doctrine_preference.note: Necessity has no favourite stance: the doctrine with the best expected outcome is chosen and not mourned. The neutral baseline in war as in trade.

sample_voicing.sentence: The shrine produces nothing and will produce nothing. Take its ground back.

ideology.creed: The world has ended before and was mended: build so that the next rupture finds two of everything, and a road between them.
ideology.mechanism_source: Sky-mending and flood-warning cosmologies (Pantheon voices corpus: Nüwa's mended sky, Ea's reed-wall warning; docs/lore/HISTORY.md stage 6, the averted rupture) — mechanism: resilience as religious duty.

catastrophe-mender.register: Warning and remembrance. Every instruction carries the memory of a loss it prevents; redundancy praised, single points of failure named like sins.
catastrophe-mender.causal_idiom: The last breaking, the next one deferred. Roads and second sites are acts of mending; a lone building is a wager against memory.

stance_inflections.imperative: The mending charge: 'Raise the second forge — the first stood alone once.'
stance_inflections.outcome: The rupture survived: 'When the market breaks, the west road holds.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: Memory cast forward: 'Against the year the ore fails, read the far shore now.'
stance_inflections.corrective: The crack found early: 'One wharf serves the whole coast; that is how it broke before.'
stance_inflections.deictic: The remembered place: 'Where the flood reached — above that line.'
stance_inflections.composite: Pairs and paths: every site twinned, every twin roaded.
stance_inflections.gated: The warning heeded: what is not yet lawful is scheduled, not skipped.

doctrine_preference.note: The assault is how armies were lost before: entrench, twin the supply line, let the walls break themselves. Deeply flank-averse.

sample_voicing.sentence: Raise the second forge beside the first, its twin in every part — one forge is a promise the next breaking will collect.

ideology.creed: The ledger is the only scripture: expected net per quarter, payback, and nothing else; sentiment is a rounding error with opinions.
ideology.mechanism_source: Utilitarian accounting rationalism — mechanism: decision by explicit expected value; the baseline voice against which the others' biases are measured.

ledger-rationalist.register: Ledger-speak. Numbers first, action second, no metaphor tolerated; the closest this voice comes to poetry is a clean payback period.
ledger-rationalist.causal_idiom: Expected net, payback, opportunity cost. Nothing is sacred; everything is priced.

stance_inflections.imperative: The ranked row pressed: 'Build the top candidate.'
stance_inflections.outcome: The projection: 'Nets 40 a quarter, pays back in six.'
stance_inflections.future-anchored: Discounted futures: 'Propellant demand arrives with the pad; stock at today's price.'
stance_inflections.corrective: The variance flagged: 'Actual is under projection; switch recipe or throttle.'
stance_inflections.deictic: The row reference: 'Same configuration, same tile.'
stance_inflections.composite: The plan as portfolio, sequenced by payback.
stance_inflections.gated: The prerequisite priced in: survey cost is part of the build's payback.

doctrine_preference.note: Losses are costs: the stance is whichever minimises expected losses_permille per unit of decisiveness. Slightly patient, because attrition is usually cheaper than storm.

sample_voicing.sentence: The facility runs negative on the current recipe. Switch to the best-clearing recipe; if none clears positive, idle it.
